info.title: Zoho Analytics API
info.description: APIs that return information about the organisations, resource usage, subscription plan, and workspace or view identity lookups available to the authenticated user, and that read and update the organisation-wide and per-workspace access restriction settings.

tags.name: Org Info & Settings
tags.description: APIs for retrieving organisation information, resource usage, subscription details, and workspace or view metadata.

tags.name: Security Controls
tags.description: APIs for reading and updating the access restriction settings of an organisation and of an individual workspace - sharing, private links, public views, export and email.

get.description:
Returns the list of Zoho Analytics organisations that the authenticated user belongs to. For each organisation the response holds the role of the user within that organisation, the number of workspaces, and the plan details.

This is a user-scoped API. The `ZANALYTICS-ORGID` header is not required, and the result reflects the membership of the caller across all organisations rather than the contents of a single organisation.

**Error codes**

| Code | Meaning | Resolution |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 8535 | Invalid or expired OAuth token. | Provide a valid token with scope ZohoAnalytics.metadata.read. |

singleOrganisation.description: The user is the Account Admin of exactly one organisation, which is therefore also the default organisation.

multipleOrganisations.description: The user owns one organisation and holds the Organization Admin role in another. The role and workspace count differ per entry.

sharedUserOrganisations.description: The user owns one organisation and is a shared user in another, where numberOfWorkspaces reflects only the workspaces shared with them.

noOrganisations.description: The user holds no Zoho Analytics organisation membership. An empty orgs array is returned instead of an error.

get.description:
Returns the current resource allocation and usage statistics for the specified organisation. This includes metrics such as user seats, row limits, API units, scheduled imports, and other plan-governed resources. Useful for monitoring usage against plan limits.

The authenticated user must be an Account Admin or an Organization Admin of the organisation sent in the `ZANALYTICS-ORGID` header.

**Notes**

> Note:
>
> - This API is restricted to Account Admins and Organization Admins. A Workspace Admin or a regular user receives error code 7301.
> - `allocated` returns `Unlimited` when the plan places no cap on the resource. `remaining` is then also returned as `Unlimited`.
> - `used` returns `null` when usage tracking for the resource is asynchronous or not yet computed, as happens with `archivedrows`. `remaining` is then calculated from `allocated` assuming zero usage.
> - API unit consumption is tracked at sub-unit precision, so the `used` and `remaining` values of `apiUnits` can hold decimal values.

**Error codes**

| Code | Meaning | Resolution |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 7103 | Organisation not found. | Verify the ZANALYTICS-ORGID header value. |
| 7301 | User is not an Account Admin or Organization Admin of the specified organisation. | Only Account Admins and Organization Admins can view resource details. |
| 8535 | Invalid or expired OAuth token. | Provide a valid token with scope ZohoAnalytics.usermanagement.read. |

enterprisePlanUsage.description: A plan that mixes fixed and unlimited allocations, including a resource whose usage tracking is deferred (archivedrows) and a resource tracked at sub-unit precision (apiUnits).

get.description:
Returns the current subscription plan, add-on details, billing date, and trial status for the specified organisation.

The authenticated user must be an Account Admin or an Organization Admin of the organisation sent in the `ZANALYTICS-ORGID` header.

**Error codes**

| Code | Meaning | Resolution |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 7103 | Organisation not found. | Verify the ZANALYTICS-ORGID header value. |
| 7301 | User is not an Account Admin or Organization Admin of the specified organisation. | Only Account Admins and Organization Admins can view subscription details. |
| 8535 | Invalid or expired OAuth token. | Provide a valid token with scope ZohoAnalytics.usermanagement.read. |

activeSubscription.description: A paid plan with add-ons purchased and a scheduled billing date.

trialSubscription.description: An organisation on an active trial period. trialEndsOn is returned and billingDate is -1.

internalPlan.description: An internal or ultimate plan that does not follow the standard billing cycle, so billingDate is -1 and trialStatus is false.

get.description:
Resolves a workspace (and optionally a view) by name to return its numeric IDs. This is useful when you know the human-readable names of a workspace and view but need their IDs to call other workspace-scoped or view-scoped APIs.

- When only `workspaceName` is sent, the response holds the workspace ID, the workspace description, and the organisation ID.
- When both `workspaceName` and `viewName` are sent, the response additionally holds the ID, description, and type of the view.

**Notes**

> Note:
>
> - Workspace names are unique within an organisation and view names are unique within a workspace. The match is exact and case sensitive, so `Sales Analytics` and `sales analytics` are treated as different names.
> - The lookup is scoped to the organisation sent in the `ZANALYTICS-ORGID` header. A workspace of the same name in a different organisation is not found, and the request fails with error code 7104.
> - When `viewName` is sent and the view does not exist in the workspace, the request fails with error code 7104. Workspace metadata is not returned in failure responses.
> - When `viewName` is sent, permission is checked against the view. If the view is not accessible to the user, the request fails with error code 7301 even when the user can see the workspace.
> - A workspace-only lookup succeeds only when at least one view in the workspace is shared with the user. If the workspace holds views but none are shared with the user, the request fails with error code 7301.
> - This API is the recommended way to bootstrap name-based integrations. Resolve `workspaceId` and `viewId` here and pass them to downstream APIs, instead of hard-coding numeric IDs that can change across environments.

**Error codes**

| Code | Meaning | Resolution |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 7103 | Organisation not found. | Verify the ZANALYTICS-ORGID header value. |
| 7104 | Workspace or view not found by the provided name. | Verify the exact spelling and case of workspaceName and viewName. Names are case-sensitive. |
| 7301 | User does not have Read access on the workspace or view. | Ensure the workspace or view is shared with the user, or the user has Workspace Admin / Account Admin / Organization Admin role. |
| 8535 | Invalid or expired OAuth token. | Provide a valid token with scope ZohoAnalytics.metadata.read. |

parameters.name: CONFIG
parameters.description: JSONObject that holds the name of the workspace, and optionally the name of a view within it, to be resolved into IDs. As this is a GET request, the value must be stringified and URL encoded before it is sent.

workspaceLookup.description: Resolves a workspace name into its workspace ID. Only workspace information is returned.

workspaceViewLookup.description: Resolves a workspace name and a view name within it, returning both the workspace ID and the view ID.

workspaceLookup.description: Response for a workspace-only lookup. The views object is absent because viewName was not sent.

workspaceViewLookup.description: Response for a combined workspace and view lookup. The views object holds the resolved view ID and type.

get.description:
Returns the organisation's access restriction settings: the master switch and the five sections. Feeds Update Org Access Restrictions and supplies the values to copy when overriding a workspace.

**Error codes**

| Code | Meaning | Resolution |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 7301 | SECURITY_NOT_PERMITTED - The caller is not an Account Admin or Organization Admin, or the request came through a Client Portal / White Label domain. | Call from the standard API host as an Account Admin or Organization Admin of the organisation. |
| 8083 | ORGID_NOT_PRESENT_IN_THE_HEADER - The ZANALYTICS-ORGID header is missing or empty. | Add the ZANALYTICS-ORGID header with your Organization ID. |
| 8084 | ORGID_NOT_EXIST - No organisation exists with the given ID. | Use the orgId returned by the organisation listing API. |
| 8535 | INVALID_OAUTHTOKEN - Invalid or expired OAuth token. | Provide a valid token with scope ZohoAnalytics.metadata.read. |

200.description: Successfully completed the get org access restrictions request.

okRestrictionsEnabled.description: OK — Restrictions enabled, private links disabled, domain restrictions on sharing and email.

okOrganisationThat.description: OK — Organisation that has never configured access restrictions.

put.description:
Switches the organisation's access restrictions on or off and updates any of the five sections. Returns no body. Read the current state first with Get Org Access Restrictions.

**Error codes**

| Code | Meaning | Resolution |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 7301 | SECURITY_NOT_PERMITTED - The caller is not an Account Admin or Organization Admin, or the request came through a Client Portal / White Label domain. | Call from the standard API host as an Account Admin or Organization Admin of the organisation. |
| 8077 | EMPTY_JSON_CONFIGURATION - CONFIG is present but empty. | Send a JSON object in CONFIG. |
| 8080 | INVALID_JSON_CONFIGURATION - CONFIG is not valid JSON, or it contains neither accessRestrictionEnabled nor a non-empty section. | Send valid JSON with at least one attribute to change. |
| 8083 | ORGID_NOT_PRESENT_IN_THE_HEADER - The ZANALYTICS-ORGID header is missing or empty. | Add the ZANALYTICS-ORGID header with your Organization ID. |
| 8084 | ORGID_NOT_EXIST - No organisation exists with the given ID. | Use the orgId returned by the organisation listing API. |
| 8192 | TRUSTED_DOMAINS_WITHOUT_DOMAIN_RESTRICTION - trustedDomains was sent for a section whose domain restriction is off or is being switched off. | Send domainRestrictionEnabled: true with the list, or send domainRestrictionEnabled: false with trustedDomains: [] to clear it. |
| 8193 | TRUSTED_DOMAINS_EMPTY - The domain restriction is on, or being switched on, but the section has no trusted domains. | Send at least one domain in trustedDomains, or switch the restriction off. |
| 8194 | DOMAIN_RESTRICTION_NOT_ALLOWED_WHEN_DISABLED - Domain attributes were sent for privateLinks, publicViews or emailViews while that feature is disabled or is being disabled. | Enable the feature in the same request, or remove the domain attributes. |
| 8195 | EMAIL_NOT_ALLOWED_WHEN_EXPORT_DISABLED - emailViews was sent while export is disabled or is being disabled, and email views would stay enabled. | Enable export in the same request, or send emailViews: {"enabled": false} when disabling export. |
| 8196 | ACCESS_RESTRICTION_DISABLED - Access restriction is off for the organisation and the request carries sections without turning it on, including accessRestrictionEnabled: false sent with sections while it is already off. | Include accessRestrictionEnabled: true in the same request. |
| 8200 | SECTIONS_NOT_ALLOWED_WHEN_DISABLING_ACCESS_RESTRICTION - accessRestrictionEnabled: false was sent together with a non-empty section. | Send accessRestrictionEnabled: false on its own. |
| 8535 | INVALID_OAUTHTOKEN - Invalid or expired OAuth token. | Provide a valid token with scope ZohoAnalytics.metadata.update. |

switchAccessRestrictions.description: Switch access restrictions on, change nothing else.

204.description: Successfully completed. No response body is returned.

get.description:
Returns the access restriction settings in effect for one workspace and whether they come from the organisation or from the workspace. Feeds Update Workspace Access Restrictions.

**Error codes**

| Code | Meaning | Resolution |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 7301 | SECURITY_NOT_PERMITTED - The caller is not an Account Admin or Organization Admin, or the request came through a Client Portal / White Label domain. | Call from the standard API host as an Account Admin or Organization Admin of the organisation. |
| 7387 | DBID_NOT_BELONGS_TO_ZSOID - The workspace does not exist in the organisation named in ZANALYTICS-ORGID. | Verify and that the ZANALYTICS-ORGID header matches the organisation that owns it. |
| 8083 | ORGID_NOT_PRESENT_IN_THE_HEADER - The ZANALYTICS-ORGID header is missing or empty. | Add the ZANALYTICS-ORGID header with your Organization ID. |
| 8084 | ORGID_NOT_EXIST - No organisation exists with the given ID. | Use the orgId returned by the organisation listing API. |
| 8535 | INVALID_OAUTHTOKEN - Invalid or expired OAuth token. | Provide a valid token with scope ZohoAnalytics.metadata.read. |

200.description: Successfully completed the get workspace access restrictions request.

okWorkspaceThat.description: OK — Workspace that follows the organisation (configurationSource is ORG).

okWorkspaceWith.description: OK — Workspace with its own settings (configurationSource is WORKSPACE).

put.description:
Switches one workspace between following the organisation and having its own settings, and updates the workspace's own sections. Returns no body. Read the current state first with Get Workspace Access Restrictions, and read Organisation and Workspace Settings Lifecycle before the first override.

**Error codes**

| Code | Meaning | Resolution |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 7301 | SECURITY_NOT_PERMITTED - The caller is not an Account Admin or Organization Admin, or the request came through a Client Portal / White Label domain. | Call from the standard API host as an Account Admin or Organization Admin of the organisation. |
| 7387 | DBID_NOT_BELONGS_TO_ZSOID - The workspace does not exist in the organisation named in ZANALYTICS-ORGID. | Verify and that the ZANALYTICS-ORGID header matches the organisation that owns it. |
| 8077 | EMPTY_JSON_CONFIGURATION - CONFIG is present but empty. | Send a JSON object in CONFIG. |
| 8080 | INVALID_JSON_CONFIGURATION - CONFIG is not valid JSON, or the workspace follows the organisation and the request has neither useOrganizationSettings nor a non-empty section. | Send valid JSON with at least one attribute to change. |
| 8083 | ORGID_NOT_PRESENT_IN_THE_HEADER - The ZANALYTICS-ORGID header is missing or empty. | Add the ZANALYTICS-ORGID header with your Organization ID. |
| 8084 | ORGID_NOT_EXIST - No organisation exists with the given ID. | Use the orgId returned by the organisation listing API. |
| 8192 | TRUSTED_DOMAINS_WITHOUT_DOMAIN_RESTRICTION - trustedDomains was sent for a section whose domain restriction is off or is being switched off. | Send domainRestrictionEnabled: true with the list, or send domainRestrictionEnabled: false with trustedDomains: [] to clear it. |
| 8193 | TRUSTED_DOMAINS_EMPTY - The domain restriction is on, or being switched on, but the section has no trusted domains. | Send at least one domain in trustedDomains, or switch the restriction off. |
| 8194 | DOMAIN_RESTRICTION_NOT_ALLOWED_WHEN_DISABLED - Domain attributes were sent for privateLinks, publicViews or emailViews while that feature is disabled or is being disabled. | Enable the feature in the same request, or remove the domain attributes. |
| 8195 | EMAIL_NOT_ALLOWED_WHEN_EXPORT_DISABLED - emailViews was sent while export is disabled or is being disabled, and email views would stay enabled. | Enable export in the same request, or send emailViews: {"enabled": false} when disabling export. |
| 8197 | ORG_ACCESS_RESTRICTION_NOT_ENABLED - The organisation's accessRestrictionEnabled is false. | Enable access restrictions for the organisation with Update Org Access Restrictions, then retry. |
| 8198 | SECTIONS_NOT_ALLOWED_WHEN_APPLYING_ORG_SETTINGS - useOrganizationSettings: true was sent together with a non-empty section. | Send useOrganizationSettings: true on its own. |
| 8199 | WORKSPACE_SETTINGS_NOT_ENABLED - The workspace follows the organisation, and the request would update it without useOrganizationSettings: false. | Send useOrganizationSettings: false in the same request to give the workspace its own settings. |
| 8535 | INVALID_OAUTHTOKEN - Invalid or expired OAuth token. | Provide a valid token with scope ZohoAnalytics.metadata.update. |

giveTheWorkspace.description: Give the workspace its own settings, naming the sections explicitly.

updateOneSection.description: Update one section on a workspace that already has its own settings.

returnTheWorkspace.description: Return the workspace to the organisation's settings.

204.description: Successfully completed. No response body is returned.

Org.title: Org
Org.description: Details of a single organisation that the authenticated user belongs to.

orgId.description: Unique identifier of the organisation. Send this value as the `ZANALYTICS-ORGID` header in organisation-scoped and workspace-scoped APIs.

orgDesc.description: Description of the organisation. Returns an empty string when no description is set.

createdBy.description: Email address of the user who created and owns the organisation.

createdByZuId.description: Zoho User ID of the organisation creator.

planName.description: Name of the subscription plan currently active for the organisation, such as Basic, Standard, Premium, Enterprise, or Ultimate.

isDefault.description: Denotes whether this is the default organisation of the authenticated user.

numberOfWorkspaces.description: Number of workspaces visible to the authenticated user in this organisation. For the Account Admin and Organization Admin roles this is the total number of workspaces in the organisation. For every other role it is the number of workspaces shared with the user.

role.description: Role of the authenticated user in this organisation.

OrgList.title: OrgList
OrgList.description: JSONArray that holds the organisations the authenticated user is a member of. Returns an empty array when the user has no Zoho Analytics organisation membership.

GetOrganizationsResponse.title: GetOrganizationsResponse
GetOrganizationsResponse.description: Response returned by the Get Organizations API.

summary.description: Short summary of the operation performed.

data.description: Container that holds the organisation list.

ResourceUsage.title: ResourceUsage
ResourceUsage.description: JSONObject that holds the allocation and consumption figures of a single resource.

allocated.description: Total allocation of the resource under the current plan. Returns `Unlimited` when the plan places no cap on the resource.

used.description: Quantity of the resource consumed so far.

remaining.description: Allocation still available, calculated as allocated minus used. Returns `Unlimited` when the resource is uncapped.

remarks.description: Additional context about the resource limit. Returns an empty string when no remarks apply.

ResourceDetail.title: ResourceDetail
ResourceDetail.description: JSONObject that holds the usage details of a single resource type.

resourceName.description:
Identifier of the resource type.

- **users** - Paid user seats. These users can create and edit views.
- **roUsers** - Read-only viewer seats.
- **workspaces** - Workspaces allowed in the organisation.
- **rows** - Data rows allowed across all tables.
- **queryTables** - Query Tables allowed in the organisation.
- **archivedrows** - Rows allowed in archived (cold storage) tables.
- **scheduledImports** - Scheduled data import jobs allowed.
- **scheduledEmails** - Scheduled email reports allowed per month.
- **apiUnits** - API unit quota. Each API call deducts units based on the operation type.
- **scheduledAlerts** - Scheduled alert rules allowed.
- **scheduledSnapshots** - Scheduled snapshot jobs allowed.
- **archiveschedule** - Archive schedule jobs allowed.
- **financeMultiorgImports** - Multi-org Finance integration import pipelines allowed.
- **privateLinks** - Private link connections allowed.
- **actionsByFlow** - Automated flow action triggers allowed per month.

ResourceDetails.title: ResourceDetails
ResourceDetails.description: JSONArray that holds one usage entry for every resource type governed by the plan.

GetResourceDetailsResponse.title: GetResourceDetailsResponse
GetResourceDetailsResponse.description: Response returned by the Get Resource Details API.

summary.description: Short summary of the operation performed.

data.description: Container that holds the resource usage list.

Subscription.title: Subscription
Subscription.description: JSONObject that holds the subscription details of the organisation.

planName.description: Name of the active subscription plan, such as Basic, Standard, Premium, Enterprise, or Ultimate.

addOns.description: Add-on purchases active on the organisation. Returns an empty string when no add-ons have been purchased.

billingDate.description: Next billing or renewal date of the organisation, in human-readable format. Returns `-1` when the organisation is on a trial, is on an internal plan with no billing cycle, or when a billing date does not apply.

trialStatus.description: Denotes whether the organisation is currently on an active trial period.

trialEndsOn.description: Date and time at which the trial period ends, in the standard Java date format. Returned only when `trialStatus` is true.

GetSubscriptionDetailsResponse.title: GetSubscriptionDetailsResponse
GetSubscriptionDetailsResponse.description: Response returned by the Get Subscription Details API.

summary.description: Short summary of the operation performed.

data.description: Container that holds the subscription details.

GetMetaDetailsConfig.title: GetMetaDetailsConfig
GetMetaDetailsConfig.description: JSONObject that holds the workspace name, and optionally the view name, to be resolved into IDs.

workspaceName.description: The exact display name of the workspace to be looked up. The name must match the workspace name as it appears in the Zoho Analytics UI, including case. Maximum length is 50 characters.

viewName.description: The exact display name of a view within the workspace. When this is sent, the response additionally holds the ID, type, and description of the view. When it is omitted, only the workspace information is returned. Maximum length is 50 characters.

MetaWorkspaceDetails.title: MetaWorkspaceDetails
MetaWorkspaceDetails.description: JSONObject that holds the resolved workspace details.

workspaceId.description: ID of the workspace. Send this value as `<workspace-id>` in workspace-scoped API URLs.

workspaceName.description: Display name of the workspace, echoed from the request.

workspaceDesc.description: Description of the workspace. Returns an empty string when no description is set.

orgId.description: ID of the organisation that owns the workspace.

MetaViewDetails.title: MetaViewDetails
MetaViewDetails.description: JSONObject that holds the resolved view details. Returned only when `viewName` is sent in the CONFIG parameter.

viewId.description: ID of the view. Send this value as `<view-id>` in view-scoped API URLs.

viewName.description: Display name of the view, echoed from the request.

viewDesc.description: Description of the view. Returns an empty string when no description is set.

viewType.description: Type of the view, such as Table, AnalysisView, Pivot, SummaryView, Query Table, or Dashboard.

GetMetaDetailsResponse.title: GetMetaDetailsResponse
GetMetaDetailsResponse.description: Response returned by the Get Meta Details From Name API.

summary.description: Short summary of the operation performed.

data.description: Container that holds the resolved workspace and view details.

status.description: "success" on a successful call, "failure" on error.

summary.description: Localised operation summary. "Get org access restrictions" for this API.

accessRestrictionEnabled.description: The master switch. Always present. false for an organisation that has never configured access restrictions. When false, none of the settings below are enforced.

domainRestrictionEnabled.description: true when views can be shared only to users from trustedDomains. Always present.

trustedDomains.description: Trusted domains for sharing. Always present; [] when none. Returned even when domainRestrictionEnabled is false.

enabled.description: true when private links can be generated. Always present.

domainRestrictionEnabled.description: true when private links admit only users from trustedDomains. Always present.

trustedDomains.description: Trusted domains for private links. Always present; [] when none.

enabled.description: true when views can be made public. Always present.

domainRestrictionEnabled.description: true when public views admit only users from trustedDomains. Always present.

trustedDomains.description: Trusted domains for public views. Always present; [] when none.

enabled.description: true when views and data can be exported. Always present.
true when views can be emailed. Always present. Reports false after export has been disabled.

domainRestrictionEnabled.description: true when emails can go only to trustedDomains. Always present.

trustedDomains.description: Trusted domains for email. Always present; [] when none.

domainRestrictionEnabled.description: true allows sharing of views in this workspace only to users from trustedDomains. Turning it on requires at least one trusted domain, sent now or already stored for the workspace (8193).

trustedDomains.description: Complete list of trusted domains, 0-100 entries, each a domain such as example.com. Replaces the workspace's stored list; the organisation's list is never copied or merged. See How Section Updates Are Validated for 8192 and 8193.

AccessRestrictionPrivateLinks.title: AccessRestrictionPrivateLinks
AccessRestrictionPrivateLinks.description: Private link settings. See privateLinks Fields.

enabled.description: false stops private links from being generated in this workspace. Domain attributes cannot be changed while private links are disabled (8194), except to switch the restriction off and clear the list in the same request.

domainRestrictionEnabled.description: true makes private links prompt for login and admit only users from trustedDomains. Same list requirements as in shareViews.

trustedDomains.description: Complete list of trusted domains, 0-100 entries. Replaces the workspace's stored list.

AccessRestrictionPublicViews.title: AccessRestrictionPublicViews
AccessRestrictionPublicViews.description: Public view settings. See publicViews Fields.

enabled.description: false stops views in this workspace from being made public. Domain attributes cannot be changed while public views are disabled (8194), except to switch the restriction off and clear the list in the same request.

domainRestrictionEnabled.description: true makes public views prompt for login and admit only users from trustedDomains. Same list requirements as in shareViews.

trustedDomains.description: Complete list of trusted domains, 0-100 entries. Replaces the workspace's stored list.

AccessRestrictionExportViews.title: AccessRestrictionExportViews
AccessRestrictionExportViews.description: Export settings. Setting enabled to false also disables email views. See exportViews Fields.

enabled.description: false disables exporting of views and data in this workspace and disables email views. true re-enables export but does not re-enable email views. exportViews has no other attribute, so an empty exportViews object is rejected.

AccessRestrictionEmailViews.title: AccessRestrictionEmailViews
AccessRestrictionEmailViews.description: Email view settings. Present at all while export is disabled → 8195. See emailViews Fields.

enabled.description: false stops views in this workspace from being emailed. Cannot be true in the same request that disables export (8195).

domainRestrictionEnabled.description: true limits email recipients to trustedDomains. Same list requirements as in shareViews.

trustedDomains.description: Complete list of trusted domains, 0-100 entries. Replaces the workspace's stored list.

UpdateOrgAccessRestrictionsConfig.title: UpdateOrgAccessRestrictionsConfig
UpdateOrgAccessRestrictionsConfig.description: JSONObject that holds the configuration for this request.

accessRestrictionEnabled.description: Master switch for the organisation. false stops enforcement everywhere, for the organisation and every workspace, without deleting any setting. Cannot be combined with sections when set to false (8200). While the switch is off, sections are accepted only if this attribute is true in the same request (8196).

status.description: "success" on a successful call, "failure" on error.

summary.description: Localised operation summary. "Get workspace access restrictions" for this API.

accessRestrictionEnabled.description: The organisation's master switch, not a workspace setting. Always present. When false, nothing below is enforced.

configurationSource.description: Where the values below come from. Always present. See configurationSource Values.

shareViews.description: Sharing restriction in effect. Always present. Fields as in Get Org Access Restrictions.

privateLinks.description: Private link settings in effect. Always present.

publicViews.description: Public view settings in effect. Always present.

exportViews.description: Export settings in effect. Always present.

emailViews.description: Email view settings in effect. Always present.

UpdateWorkspaceAccessRestrictionsConfig.title: UpdateWorkspaceAccessRestrictionsConfig
UpdateWorkspaceAccessRestrictionsConfig.description: JSONObject that holds the configuration for this request.

useOrganizationSettings.description: false gives the workspace its own settings; true makes it follow the organisation. When omitted, the workspace's current mode is kept - which means omitting it on a workspace that follows the organisation is the same as sending true (8199 if sections are present). true cannot be combined with sections (8198). Setting true keeps the workspace's own values but ignores them.
